articles.summary: The 2026 Lloyd's Register Foundation World Risk Poll, conducted by Gallup, found that one in three U.S. adults (34%) identify road-related accidents as the daily safety risk they're most concerned about, making roadway crashes Americans' top everyday safety concern. It's a telling finding, but perhaps not a surprising one. Road safety touches nearly everyone,
articles.title: One in Three Americans Cite Crashes as Top Safety Concern: New Data Offers Reason for Optimism
